Operating Squad

Engineered for the unglamorous truth of physical work.

Inbound Surveillance Edge Systems // Phnom Penh, Cambodia

Inbound Surveillance is built by a Phnom Penh-based engineering squad from Kirirom Institute of Technology Hub, deploying autonomous edge infrastructure directly to the garage floor. We don’t build cloud dashboards for air-conditioned offices; we solve the chronic leakage of unbilled labor where mechanics work with 10W-40, transmission fluid, and bare metal.

By using face recognition only to identify the mechanic, then tracking full-body movement when faces disappear under hoods or lifts, our on-site hardware captures billable wrench-time to the second—delivering zero-click daily scorecards straight to shop owners on Telegram without a single tablet on the floor.

What we ship

  • Face ID as handshake — full-body tracking keeps the session alive under hoods and lifts.
  • Dual clocks: billable wrench-time and payroll attendance.
  • On-site processing — no cloud video stream.
  • Telegram scorecards via @Inbound_Surveillance_bot.
